SELECT A.BND_TTL, A.JEMOK, A.RC_CODE, A.RC_RFILE_NO, A.RC_RITEM_NO, B.ORG_FILE_PATH, B.ORG_FILE_NAME, B.SAVE_FILE_NAME, C.FILE_NAME, C.CONTENTS, C.INDEXING_CONTENTS, C.ZIP_SEQ, C.ZIP_ENTRY_FILE_NAME, C.FILE_TYPE, C.FILE_GUBUN FROM CN_RITEM A JOIN CN_ELEC_DOC B ON A.RC_RFILE_NO = B.RC_RFILE_NO AND A.RC_RITEM_NO = B.RC_RITEM_NO AND B.TRANSFERYEAR = #{transferYear} JOIN EXTRACT_ELEC_DOC C ON B.RC_RFILE_NO = C.RC_RFILE_NO AND B.RC_RITEM_NO = C.RC_RITEM_NO AND B.SAVE_FILE_NAME = C.FILE_NAME AND C.EXTRACT_STATUS = 'PASS' WHERE C.INDEXING_CONTENTS IS NOT NULL AND C.INDEXING_CONTENTS <> ''
AND (C.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS IS NULL OR C.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS <> 'PASS')
AND C.LLM_SUMMARY_STATUS IS NULL
ORDER BY A.RC_RFILE_NO, A.RC_RITEM_NO, C.FILE_NAME, C.ZIP_SEQ LIMIT #{limit}
